newsitem.title: USA: Town & Country to close distribution unit.
newsitem.headline: Town & Country to close distribution unit.

text.p: Town & Country Corp., a maker of fine jewelry, said Tuesday it will close its Dallas distribution facility as part of its restructuring to cut costs.
The company said it will transfer the operations to its headquarters in Chelsea, Mass., during the next two months, creating 45 jobs there.
The Dallas sales force will remain in Texas, it said.
Town & Country also has manufacturing facilities in New York, Hong Kong and Bangkok, Thailand and has 1,300 employees worldwide.
Town & Country's stock edged up 6.25 cents to 37.5 cents on the American Stock Exchange.
